title: Text: DET David Chadd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: U doing a story on the front office?
Ok Tom Moore was asking me and he said you talked to me? So was just wandering
I just asked if I could talk to him tomorrow.

Basically, it's going to be a profile on Al's team. You, Scott Bream, Littlefield, Jay, Scott Pleis, Tom Moore. The guys tasked with rebuild. Who you are, what you do, how you got here. Showing the readers that you all are baseball guys and org is good hands
Also want to tie in Al being the leader and loyalty and all that. Will be gd
